_header.purpose: Per-item answer contract for the 560 SpectraCQ-Core items. answer_type and answer_columns are the graded contract. ordering_key and cardinality are read from the item reference query (ORDER BY, LIMIT) and are null where the query imposes none. contract_disposition records, per item, what would have to change for the item to hold exactly as asked.

disposition_labels.2: question text is the only thing that would have to change
disposition_labels.3: mapping or multi-valued semantics a flat-set scorer cannot express
disposition_labels.4: not repairable in place: the graded answer is not determined by the item
